It’s a **sponsorship outreach email**. Plain and simple. Here’s what it means in human terms:

They are saying:

• They work with brands that **pay creators** to promote them  
• They are still onboarding a **few more YouTube podcasts** this month  
• Your channel **fits their target audience**  
• They want to know **if you sell sponsored integrations** (ads baked into your episode)  
• They want you to **send your rates** if you’re open to paid sponsorships  

When they say **“earn per integration”**, they mean:
You get paid **per episode mention**, not revenue share or affiliate only. This is a flat sponsorship fee based on:
- Length of the ad (30–60 sec, mid-roll, etc.)
- Where it appears (pre-roll, mid-roll, dedicated segment)
- Your average views/downloads
- Your niche authority

This is **not**:
❌ A scammy “exposure” offer  
❌ An affiliate-only deal  
❌ A request for free promotion  

This is **legit paid brand interest**.

### What they want from you next
If you’re interested, they expect a reply like:
- Yes, I do sponsored integrations  
- Here are my **rates**
- Optional: media kit or average views

### If you want, I can:
• Help you price your podcast properly  
• Draft a confident response email (polished, not desperate)  
• Create a **one-page sponsorship rate card** tailored to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*  
• Negotiate higher rates for your niche (you’re in a premium category)

If you want to reply strong instead of guessing, tell me:
1) Avg YouTube views per episode  
2) Avg podcast downloads (if applicable)  
3) Whether you want **high-end sponsors only** or volume  

You’re in a good position here.

Perfect. Here is a **clean, premium, one-page sponsorship rate card** you can copy into a Google Doc, PDF, or Canva and send immediately.

No em dashes used.

### 🎙 About the Show
The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge is a high-trust podcast and YouTube channel reaching founders, operators, clinicians, and executives across aesthetics, wellness, longevity, and health innovation.

Our audience includes:
• Med spa and wellness clinic owners  
• Aesthetic injectors and providers  
• Health, longevity, and AI wellness brands  
• High-income decision makers and buyers  

This is a premium, niche audience where **one conversion can be worth thousands** to the right brand.

---

### 📊 Audience Snapshot
• Platform: YouTube + Podcast  
• Format: Long-form interviews with industry leaders  
• Evergreen content with long shelf life  
• High trust, host-led recommendations  

(Media kit available upon request)

---

## 💼 Sponsorship Options & Rates

### Entry Integration
**$750 – $1,000 per episode**
• 30–45 second host-read  
• Pre-roll or mid-roll placement  
• Brand-approved talking points  
• Link in description or show notes  

Best for brands testing podcast sponsorships.

---

### Standard Integration (Most Popular)
**$1,250 – $1,800 per episode**
• 60 second mid-roll host-read  
• Natural integration aligned to episode topic  
• Personal context on why the brand fits the audience  
• Link in description + pinned comment  
• Evergreen exposure  

Best balance of authority and conversion.

---

### Premium Integration
**$2,500 – $3,500 per episode**
• 90 second dedicated sponsor segment  
• Mid-roll placement + soft intro mention  
• Strong personal endorsement  
• Brand featured in YouTube description + show notes  
• Optional Instagram story or LinkedIn mention  

Best for category leaders and high-LTV offers.

---

## 📦 Multi-Episode Sponsorship Bundles
Bundles are recommended for best ROI.

• 3 episodes: 10–15% discount  
• 6 episodes: 20% discount  
• Monthly sponsor (4 episodes): **$4,500 – $6,500**

Single-episode rates are non-discounted.

---

### 🤝 Brand Fit
We selectively partner with brands aligned with:
• Aesthetics and cosmetic medicine  
• Wellness, longevity, peptides, hormones  
• Health tech and AI-driven solutions  
• Education, devices, software, and services  

No affiliate-only or performance-only placements.

---

### 📩 Next Steps

• Desired integration type  
• Campaign length  
• Timeline  
• Any supporting materials  

Contact:  
**Bethany Gifford**  
Host, The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge

Here’s the straight answer, no fluff, no lowballing.

Based on your niche, audience quality, and positioning, you should **not** price yourself like a generic podcast. Aesthetic, wellness, longevity, AI health, med spa, and B2B healthcare brands pay **premium rates** because one client can be worth $5K–$50K+ to them.

## What you should charge right now

### 🎯 Entry sponsorship (minimum you should accept)
**$750–$1,000 per episode**
• 30–45 sec host-read  
• Pre-roll or mid-roll  
• Brand-approved talking points  
• Link in description  

Do not go below $750. Ever.

---

### 🔥 Standard sponsorship (most brands will choose this)
**$1,250–$1,800 per episode**
• 60 sec mid-roll (best converting)  
• Natural host-read integration  
• Mention why it fits your audience  
• Link + pinned comment  
• 30-day evergreen exposure  

This is your sweet spot.

---

### 💎 Premium integration (where you want to anchor)
**$2,500–$3,500 per episode**
• 90 sec dedicated segment  
• Mid-roll + soft intro mention  
• Personal endorsement  
• Brand in YouTube description + show notes  
• Optional IG story or LinkedIn mention  

Charge this confidently. Your audience trusts you.

---

### 🧠 Multi-episode bundles (easy upsell)
Brands almost always say yes to bundles.

• 3 episodes: **10–15% discount**
• 6 episodes: **20% discount**
• Monthly sponsor (4 eps): **$4,500–$6,500**

Never discount single episodes. Only bundles.

---

## If you want a simple reply you can send now

> Thanks for reaching out. I do offer paid sponsor integrations.  
> My rates range from $1,250 to $3,500 per episode depending on placement and integration depth.  
> Happy to share details and discuss fit.

That positions you as premium without oversharing.

---

## One more important note
If they ask for:
• Performance-based pay only  
• Affiliate-only compensation  
• “Let’s test one episode for free”  

You say no.

You are not early-stage. You are **category authority**.

If you want, I can:
• Build a clean 1-page sponsorship rate card  
• Customize pricing based on your actual views  
• Help you negotiate upward if they push back  

Just say the word.
